QUOTE: ".yaml, .yml, .json | A `path` row only. No `memberdef`, no harvest, no symbols." and "`.sh`, `.bash` | `memberdef` rows for `name() {…}`..."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says YAML/JSON get only a path row (registered in the file set) with no symbols, while shell and CMake get symbol rows, so the two groups are treated differently.
